title: A booking that keeps everyone in sync
summary: A connected appointment journey for availability, booking confirmations, reminders, and changes of plan.
challenge: A consultation business books appointments across forms, messages, and phone calls. Staff repeatedly check calendars, send reminders by hand, and update several records when a customer changes their time.
approach: Connect a booking form to agreed services, staff availability, appointment lengths, and buffer times. Check availability when a booking is confirmed, create the customer record, and schedule appropriate reminders through connected channels. Let customers request a new time, update the linked calendar, and route exceptions to the team.
outcome: The proposed journey makes the appointment and its next action visible to both customer and team. It explores fewer routine scheduling exchanges and more consistent follow-up, without claiming a measured change in attendance or a live calendar integration.

workflowSteps.title: Choose a time
workflowSteps.description: The customer selects a service and an available slot that fits the booking rules.

workflowSteps.title: Confirm the booking
workflowSteps.description: Recheck availability, create the appointment, and share its confirmed details.

workflowSteps.title: Send a reminder
workflowSteps.description: Send an agreed reminder with useful preparation details and a way to request changes.

workflowSteps.title: Keep calendars aligned
workflowSteps.description: An accepted time change updates the appointment record and the connected calendar.
